description: Find transit routes near a location, optionally filtered by name or number. Returns routes with IDs, short names, and descriptions. Use routeId values to fetch schedules, vehicles, or stop sequences.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, in [-90, 90].

latSpan.description: Optional bounding-box height in degrees, as an alternative to radius. Takes effect only when lonSpan is also set, in which case radius is ignored.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, in [-180, 180].

lonSpan.description: Optional bounding-box width in degrees, as an alternative to radius. Takes effect only when latSpan is also set, in which case radius is ignored.

query.description: Filter by route name or number (e.g. "44" or "Link Light Rail").

radius.description: Search radius in meters. Must be positive; capped at 1600m. Defaults to 500m. Ignored when latSpan and lonSpan are both set.

name: onebusaway_find_routes

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if more routes exist beyond the returned set; narrow the radius or set latSpan/lonSpan to see all.

notice.description: Guidance when no routes matched — e.g. try a larger radius or different query.

query.description: Route name/number filter applied to the search, if any.

routes.description: Routes found near the specified location.

items.description: A transit route with agency and type information.

agencyId.description: Agency ID that operates this route.

agencyName.description: Agency name that operates this route.

color.description: Route brand color hex (without #), or null.

id.description: Agency-prefixed route ID (e.g. "1_100259"). Use with onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route or onebusaway_get_vehicles.

shortName.description: The number or short name displayed on vehicles (e.g. "44").

url.description: Agency schedule page URL, or null.

title: Find Routes Near Location
